summary.text: Jennifer Ambler is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 100 in the November 3, 2026 general election; the seat has no incumbent.
A small business owner and political satirist in Forsyth County, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ambler was born in Fort Myers, Florida, according to Ballotpedia, and earned a high school diploma from Fort Myers High School, a bachelor's degree from the University of Florida in 2005 and a degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 2008.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she studied political science and economics at the University of Florida, taught in Philadelphia with Teach for America, moved to New York City to pursue a performing career, and moved to Georgia in 2020.
She said she owns a small tax preparation company.
Ambler advanced unopposed from the Democratic primary for District 100 in 2024 and lost the November 2024 general election to incumbent Republican David Clark, 62.4 percent to 37.6 percent.
She won the 2026 Democratic primary unopposed on May 19, 2026; her general-election opponent is Republican Josh Clark.
She listed affordable healthcare, including Medicaid expansion, smart growth, and good government, including ranked-choice voting and fair districts, among her key campaign messages.
